## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome.

## Rationale

Explain the problem and why this approach was chosen.

## Main changes

Describe the most important implementation changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `./Scripts/test.sh`

## Screenshots or recordings

Include these for visible UI changes, or write “Not applicable.”

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated files.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private documents, local paths, or Xcode user state are included.
- [ ] Bundled dependency versions, checksums, and license notices are updated together.
